g.text: The 170 firms of figure 1's interlock core, at figure 1's coordinates, four times: one sector lit per panel, its edges in blue, the rest of the core in grey. Finance holds 47 of 170 (28%); mining, almost identical in firm
count across the whole graph (530 against 533), holds 17. Only edges touching the lit sector are drawn — the core's 1,356 edges are a grey mat at this size.
